title: Ukrainian Beef Bisque
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish made with beef stock and emulsified with butter, resulting in a rich and glassy texture, suitable for a solo dinner and diabetic friendly.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the beef stock, onion, carrot, celery, and garlic, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beef bones to the pot and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Strain the stock through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Bring the stock to a simmer and cook until it has reduced by half.
Remove the pot from the heat and whisk in the butter until it is fully incorporated and the mixture is smooth and glassy.
Season the bisque with black pepper to taste.
Serve the bisque hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
